as_told.title: Tim Taylor carries credentials from multiple intelligence agencies

plain: A man named Timothy Taylor, tied in the story to NASA and to talk of a possible secret space program, is said to carry credentials from several US intelligence agencies. Michels passes this on from the scholar Diana Pasulka, a researcher who met Taylor. He says that, according to her, Taylor seemed to "flash all these like three-letter agency credentials" at her. A researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb makes the same point without naming a source or crediting Pasulka. UAPGerb says Taylor walks around with credentials from many intelligence organisations, including access to the NRO, the agency that runs US spy satellites. If true, it would place a man who speaks about hidden programs deep inside the official security world.
